title: Render Flag
summary: Official Derivative glossary page for the Render Flag, the purple SOP/Geometry COMP flag that must be enabled alongside Render TOP Geometry parameter inclusion for geometry to render.
guidance: Use this article when Render TOP output is empty because renderability is unclear.
Ensure all three conditions align: the SOP Render flag must be on, the containing Geometry component Render flag must be on, and the Geometry component must match the Render TOP Geometry parameter.
The Render Flag also applies to Render Pass TOP rendering through the same geometry inclusion model.
Do not confuse Display Flag visibility in viewers with Render Flag visibility in Render TOP output.
